citation: Kelly MR, Yuen F, Satterfield BC, et al. Endogenous Diurnal Patterns of Adrenal and Gonadal Hormones During a 24-Hour Constant Routine After Simulated Shift Work. Journal of the Endocrine Society. 2022.
protocol: Simulated day-shift (n=7) or night-shift (n=7) for 3 days, then a 24 h constant routine (awake, semirecumbent, dim light) with blood every 3 h
population: n=14 (7 per condition), age 24.0+/-2.2 and 27.6+/-3.2 y, BMI 25.7 and 25.6; healthy; 5 of 14 female

reports.where: Table 2 (amplitude, mesor, acrophase +/- SE by prior shift condition)

note: Constant routine (no sleep) after day shift = endogenous cortisol rhythm; the night-shift arm is a manipulation. Steroids by mass spectrometry reported in pg/mL (cortisol mesor ~36,000 pg/mL, i.e. 36 ng/mL).
